$comment: Issue manifest for scripts/seed-issues.mjs. `issues` is a SEEDING QUEUE — an entry is removed automatically once the tracker owns it. `reserve` holds low-priority items that are deliberately not tracker items yet (slug, track, size, source, why — no acceptance criteria). This file OWNS the labels below: the seeder creates the missing ones and updates any whose description or colour drifted, so a label is edited here, not on the tracker. Add a `track/<lane>` per lane the project adopts (org vocabulary: infra · app · product — see issue-flow), plus `track/<crossLaneLabel>` and `needs/<lane>` if cross-lane work is marked — creating an issue with an undeclared label fails, so every label an item can carry belongs here. A track description should state that lane's routing test in this project's own document names.

labels.name: P0
labels.description: Correctness or security — fix before feature work

labels.name: P1
labels.description: User-visible breakage or a scale blocker

labels.name: P2
labels.description: Debt or cosmetic — trigger-gated, lives in the reserve
